newsitem.title: USA: World Fuel Services Q4 shr $0.43 vs $0.35.
newsitem.headline: World Fuel Services Q4 shr $0.43 vs $0.35.

text.p: Revenue increased in all three business segments, as the Company benefited from higher prices and increased business activity in aviation fueling and oil recycling. Revenue contributed by aviation fueling climbed 26.2% to $381,236,000, marine fueling revenue was $368,470,000, up 14.7%, and oil recycling added $22,912,000, an increase of 20.6% over a year ago.

Operating income for both the marine and oil recycling segments exhibited strong growth, climbing 46.4% and 26.3%, respectively. While the aviation segment improved its gross profit, higher operating expenses, primarily related to the Company's international expansion and an increase in the provision for bad debts caused a decline in this segment's income from operations. On an absolute basis, before corporate overhead, the percentage contribution in income from operations from the aviation, marine and oil recycling segments was 51.4%, 24.3%, and 24.3%, respectively.

Commenting on the results, Ralph R. Weiser, Chairman stated: "Fiscal 1997 was another record year for World Fuel Services. We witnessed growth in each of our three business segments. Perhaps the most exciting aspect of our aviation group's performance was the establishment of our international headquarters in Costa Rica. We are witnessing significant growth in many of the Central and South American markets and by being able to offer them the complete services of our aviation business, we believe we are on the threshold of continued expansion and opportunity.

Our marine business has grown as a result of both increased international activity combined with our commitment to provide financial resources and systems which facilitated the further development of the segment's operating capabilities. We are capitalizing on the strengths of both the aviation and marine segments capabilities and have begun to see the development of certain synergies that should allow World Fuel 4 Services to continue to build a larger and more profitable Company. Further, our oil recycling business continued to aggressively market its products and services which resulted in a broader customer base."

World Fuel Services Corporation is an industry leader in providing aviation fueling services to charter, cargo and passenger airlines throughout the world and is also one of the world's largest independent marine fuel services companies. The Company provides its services at more than 1,100 airports and 1,000 seaports in more than 150 countries. Additionally, the Company is a leading recycler of non-hazardous used oil in 16 southeastern and mid-Atlantic states.
